verdict.rationale: The protocols are published as open specs: ACP is Apache 2.0 and implemented by OpenAI in ChatGPT, and MPP is co-authored with Tempo, which ships its own paying CLI. ACS also spans third-party protocols such as UCP and x402. However, the documented non-Stripe implementers are co-authors (OpenAI, Tempo) rather than clearly independent adopters, and Stripe is described only as the "first" compatible PSP. Missing for 10: evidence of at least two fully independent third-party implementations (other agents, PSPs or servers), independent corroboration of ecosystem adoption, and neutral governance beyond Stripe-routed contribution.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration

citations.quote: OpenAI is the first AI platform to implement ACP with ChatGPT
ACP is open source and community-designed under the Apache 2.0 license. Businesses can implement the specification to transact with any AI agent or payment processor.
After the facilitator settles the payment on-chain, Stripe records it as a [PaymentIntent]
